g.text: Traditional Medicine
Practice Act!
TMPC
registers + licenses
+ disciplines!
FDA GHANA
registers HERBAL
PRODUCTS!
PRACTITIONERS
herbalist · TBA · bone-
setter · spiritualist
NURSE'S ROLE
ask + check + bridge
+ refer + report!
ACT 575 (exam!): Traditional Medicine Practice Act 2000 — licenses practitioners,
sets standards, punishes quacks. TMPC (Traditional Medicine Practice Council): REGISTERS
practitioners + inspects premises + disciplines + promotes safe practice. Check licenses:
"is your herbalist TMPC-registered…?" — registered = trained + traceable.
FDA GHANA: registers herbal PRODUCTS (numbers on labels!) — unregistered mixtures =
unknown contents + dose + contaminants (lead! steroids! Alles!). Teach label-reading:
FDA number + expiry + directions + "report bad reactions!" (M03!).
PRACTITIONER MAP: HERBALISTS (plant medicines — biggest group!) · TBAs (births — partner,
don't war! — refer complications!) · BONE-SETTERS (fractures — splints + praise + refer
open/complex!) · SPIRITUALISTS (prayer, rituals, "spiritual" illness) · itinerant DRUG
peddlers (UNREGULATED — warn!). Know your district's trusted names.
INTEGRATION POINTS: herbal units in SOME hospitals · TBA-TRAINING + referral slips ·
bone-setter workshops · KNUST herbal medicine degrees · pharmacopoeia monographs. Ghana
integrates — nurses BRIDGE (ask + respect + coordinate + refer both ways!).
QUACK FLAGS: secret formulas + "cures AIDS/cancer" + no licence + no fixed place + upfront
fortunes + forbids hospitals ("drips kill!") — warn + report (TMPC/police!). Hope sold
without honesty is fraud; fraud with illness is manslaughter-adjacent.
LINKS: PRO-I regulation · BEH beliefs · COM trust · M06 deepens all.
MANTRA: "licensed healers welcomed, secret cures questioned, quacks reported."
